attributes.name: Stormrune Knife
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, reveal this card to use your Dexterity or Ranged skill + 1d4+2. If proficient with weapons, you may additionally recharge this card and reveal any number of other weapons and armors to add another 1d4 for each card revealed (including this one).

When a character at another location plays a weapon on a combat check, recharge this card to add 1d4 and the Electricity trait.
